name: MOUSE
description: A tiny quiet creature that lives close to the ground; swift and careful

name: SHARK
description: A powerful predator of the deep sea; ancient and feared in the water

name: CROW
description: A clever black bird that remembers and adapts; a symbol of intelligence

name: BUTTER
description: A rich soft food made from milk; smooth and used to add warmth to cooking

name: COFFEE
description: A dark strong drink made from roasted beans; awakens the mind and body

name: PLASTIC
description: A material shaped by heat that holds its form; made by people, not found in nature

name: BRONZE
description: An ancient alloy of copper and tin; the first metal shaped by civilization

name: HEALER
description: One who restores health and wholeness; a person who mends what is broken in the body or spirit

name: NOON
description: The middle of the day when the sun is highest; the peak of daylight

name: SECOND
description: The smallest common measure of time; a brief instant that can be counted

name: HAIL
description: Frozen rain that falls as hard pellets of ice; a storm of cold striking force

name: HURRICANE
description: A vast spinning storm of wind and rain; a force of nature that destroys and reshapes

name: TORNADO
description: A violent rotating column of wind that touches the ground; sudden and destructive

name: WHEREAS
description: In contrast to the fact that; while on the other hand

name: MOREOVER
description: In addition to what has been said; further adding to the point

name: FURTHERMORE
description: Beyond what was already stated; adding more weight to the argument

name: OTHERWISE
description: In a different way; if the situation were not as described
